content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I am trying to implement timers for tracking both total program run time and pump run time in [product_name] [article_no]. My goal is to monitor up to 240 hours per year for total run, and keep the pump under 100 hours per year. Is there a more efficient way to do this than using separate counters like I have in my attached user-defined function? I need second-level resolution because I also want to include a flow counter related to pump operation. Additionally, I find the display layout for the timer inefficient since it uses three rows when fewer would suffice. Seconds and minutes only need two digits each, and hours could work with three or four digits. Is there any way to adjust the formatting so these counters only use needed display space? The second picture in the attachment shows what I mean. Any advice would be much appreciated.

Welcome to the forum, [user_name]. At the moment, there is no option to adjust the output field widths—their size depends on each block. However, you can set up a pulse generator for second-based counting, which allows up to 999,999 seconds (about 277 hours, 46 minutes, and 39 seconds). You should use a scaled time display in the message for this purpose.

Thank you! That’s just what I was looking for. I had a slight issue with the pulse generator where its timing was about 2% off in the simulator (see attachment), but after uploading code to the actual [product_name], it worked properly. It seems this timing discrepancy affects only the simulation, not the block itself. Could you assist me in setting up the HH:MM:SS display formatting? I am new to [product_name], so any detailed instructions, links, or video resources would be very helpful. Thanks in advance.

This difference only appears in simulation; when running on real [product_name], it is not an issue. For scaled time: place your cursor in an empty cell within the message text, click the '00:00' icon, and a parameter window will open. From there, you can select the block and pick the time display basis.
That was exactly what I needed! Thanks a lot for your help.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are aiming to create effective timers in [product_name] to track both overall program and pump operating times with high accuracy and concise display formatting. The default display setup wastes space because users cannot custom-format counters for seconds, minutes, and hours. Users also note that simulation irregularities with pulse generators do not translate to real hardware. There is a recurring demand for clear instructions on how to configure HH:MM:SS displays in message texts, showing that better documentation and discoverability are needed for these features.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to customize timer display formatting to optimize space usage, achieve accurate time tracking down to seconds, and easily adjust the HH:MM:SS format directly within the [product_name] environment.
